description: The eye focuses light correctly on the retina. No corrective lenses required.
recommendation: Continue regular annual eye checkups. Maintain healthy screen habits.

description: Distal objects appear blurry. Light focuses in front of the retina.
recommendation: Prescriptive glasses for distance vision. Follow 20-20-20 rule for screen use.

description: Severe distance blur. Increased risk of retinal thinning.
recommendation: Urgent consultation with an optometrist. High-index corrective lenses required.

description: Near objects may appear blurry. Extra focusing effort required.
recommendation: Reading glasses may be needed. Monitor for eye strain and headaches.

description: Significant blur at all distances, especially near. Light focuses behind retina.
recommendation: Corrective convex lenses required immediately to prevent amblyopia.
